def transform(grid):
    r0 = next(r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if 0 in row)
    c0 = grid[r0].index(0)
    h = sum(0 in row for row in grid[r0:])
    w = sum(1 for v in grid[r0] if v == 0)
    return [list(reversed(row[len(grid[0])-c0-w:len(grid[0])-c0])) for row in reversed(grid[len(grid)-r0-h:len(grid)-r0])]
